status.quote: Fireworks, the platform for specialized intelligence, today announced an expanded collaboration with NVIDIA.
status.note: Press release dated November 3, 2026; the newsroom lists no acquisition of Fireworks.

retention.value: Not stored for open models; Responses API up to 30 days when store=True
retention.quote: Fireworks does not log or store prompt or generation data for open models, without explicit user opt-in.
retention.note: The same page says Responses API conversations (store=True is the default) are kept for up to 30 days, the Batch API stores datasets, and prompt caching can hold prompt data in volatile memory for several minutes.

zdr.quote: Zero Data Retention does not apply to certain services that require data storage, including Batch API and Responses API.
zdr.note: Default for inference on open models only; the Responses API stores by default and the Batch API always stores.

zdr_how.value: On by default for open models; on the Responses API set store=False; Enterprise admins can enforce an account-wide Zero Data Retention policy
zdr_how.quote: Opt-out option: You can disable data storage by setting store=False in your API requests to prevent any conversation data from being retained.
zdr_how.note: The Enterprise policy, set under Settings → Governances → Zero Data Retention, rejects requests and jobs that would store content.

training.quote: No AI Training on Your Data: We do not use your prompts, training data, or API inputs to train or improve our AI models without your explicit opt-in.
training.note: The Terms of Service (last updated July 10, 2026) put it without the opt-in: "We will not use your Content to train our own models or to improve the Service."

attestations.quote: Fireworks has achieved all three ISO certifications covering security, privacy, and AI management:
attestations.note: The three are listed in the table under that sentence; the same page says "Fireworks is HIPAA compliant" and does not mention a BAA.

subprocessors.quote: Amazon Web Services • Cloud infrastructure and service provider
subprocessors.note: The page is a list of 21 rows, not prose; the quote is its first row and the value is every name listed.

regions.quote: Supported multi-regions: GLOBAL, US, CANADA, EUROPE, APAC.
regions.note: These are deployment regions; serverless on api.fireworks.ai has no regional restriction by default, and US-only serverless is offered for some models on us.api.fireworks.ai.

funding.quote: Today, Fireworks announced a $1.505 billion Series D at a $17.5 billion valuation, led by Atreides Management, Index Ventures, and TCV, with participation from Evantic Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Nvidia, 20VC, Bessemer Venture Partners, Menlo Ventures, and others.
